title: Program
description: Editorial program record grouping missions + fleet under a campaign narrative. Per PRD-029. Base file at static/data/programs/{id}.json; editorial prose lives in the i18n overlay (program-overlay.schema.json). The roster is program-authored (it can name missions orrery does not individually model); entry back-refs (mission.program / fleet.programs) are DERIVED from the roster's linked entries.

agencies.description: All backing agencies/operators for multinational programs (ISS, ILRS). agency is the lead.

hero.description: Hero image: a reuse ref ('missions/apollo-11/01' | 'fleet/saturn-v/01') or a program-owned image id under static/images/programs/{id}/.

roster.description: The campaign's missions + hardware. Each item is EITHER linked (linked_id + ref → an existing orrery entry, clickable) OR context-only (name + year → named but not individually modeled). The curated flagship set is NOT expanded to satisfy a roster; context items exist precisely so a program can tell its whole arc.

role.description: Optional label for fleet members (launcher, spacecraft, suit, rover, launch-site, …) or a mission descriptor.

note.description: One-line context for a roster item (esp. context-only entries).

related_programs.description: Sibling / successor / precursor program ids (Apollo → Gemini, Skylab, Artemis).

badge.description: Program insignia image (program-owned id under static/images/programs/{id}/badge, or a reuse ref). Sourced via the image pipeline. Optional until badges are sourced.

see_also.description: Deep links into orrery's own surfaces — the relevant body route (/moon, /mars, /explore) at surface/landing/science level, and program-specific /science articles.

surface_sites.description: The program's landers, rovers, and orbiters/observatories that render on a body surface — deep-linked to /moon, /mars, or /earth at ?site=<id>. Drives the 'On the surface' section.
